beats.care: Empty coolers, pots and buckets weekly. Got a fever with body pain? See a doctor and avoid self-medicating.
beats.what: Pune recorded 1,826 dengue cases from Jan 1 to Oct 10. September had 662, up from 604 last year.
beats.why: Construction sites store lots of water to cure concrete, which helps mosquitoes breed.
